semantic_authority.projection: the render plan excluding plan_digest_sha256 and execution-derived ffmpeg_invocation
semantic_authority.rule: semantic projection and digest must remain exactly unchanged across an execution successor

eligibility: predecessor is canonically incomplete/failed and not active
semantic projection and digest are unchanged
all changed paths are under the explicit execution allowlist
predecessor plan bytes and lineage identity verify

immutability.active_head: canonical pointer updated atomically under the render lock

idempotence: the same predecessor, semantic digest, invocation digest and renderer implementation digest produce the same attempt ID and reuse its existing result
output_policy: each successor has attempt-scoped staging and sidecars; the final production output path remains reserved and completion binds the successful attempt
